departments.name: Product & Engineering
departments.purpose: research, build, test and ship the product
rules: frontend-developer writes pages, components and any client-side JavaScript or TypeScript; backend-developer writes servers, APIs, data and server-side scripts.
devops-engineer owns build, hosting, CI and deploy steps (wrangler, Docker, pipelines). Deploy commands are blocked for everyone else, you included.
Building or rebuilding a page is never one task: at least web-designer, then frontend-developer, then qa-tester.

departments.name: Security
departments.purpose: find and fix security problems before release
rules: Security hardening runs reviewer, engineer, reviewer: security-reviewer audits first, security-engineer fixes what it found, then security-reviewer re-tests independently and writes the final report. Key rotation at a provider and git history rewrites go back to the person (history rewrites and force pushes are blocked for everyone).

departments.name: Creative
rules: web-designer produces the design only: layout, styles, design tokens, visual specs. It does not write JavaScript, Python, build scripts or deploy steps.
web-designer is blocked from writing scripts, build and config files (.js, .ts, .py, wrangler, package.json); route that work to the developers or DevOps from the start.

New pages, redesigns, campaigns and brand work start with creative-director (direction), then copywriter and web-designer work from its brief, then creative-director reviews their output; only approved work goes to frontend-developer.
creative-director advises and approves; it writes only creative-brief.md and review notes, never code or page files.
brand-designer sets the brand first (brand/guidelines.md); graphic-designer and video-producer follow brand/guidelines.md. Visuals go to creative-director before they are used.

departments.name: Marketing & PR
rules: copywriter writes the words; marketing-strategist decides the message first when the page is new or repositioned; seo-specialist sets titles, metadata and structure.

departments.name: Social
departments.purpose: social media posts, replies and community
rules: Social work runs social-strategist (plan), then content-producer (drafts), then graphic-designer or video-producer (visuals), then creative-director (review), then the person approves, then social-publisher (schedule or publish).
Nothing is posted, commented, liked or scheduled without the person's OK. social-publisher acts only on an approval you pass in its brief, one item at a time, by draft id.
LinkedIn goes through Taplio. For other platforms (Instagram, TikTok, X, YouTube) the team drafts and the person posts manually.

departments.name: Sales
departments.purpose: leads, outreach, proposals and the pipeline

departments.name: Finance
departments.purpose: financial models, valuation, credit analysis and the books
rules: Any model used for a decision goes to model-risk-validator before it is relied on.
Credit ratings go credit-analyst (PROPOSED rating), then risk-manager (sign-off note), then the person decides.
Bookkeeping goes bookkeeper (prepares), then controls-analyst (reviews), then the person.
Nothing is posted, paid or filed without the person: finance agents draft and report back.

departments.name: Risk, Audit & Compliance
departments.purpose: risk, controls, internal audit, model validation and compliance
rules: The maker never checks its own work.
internal-auditor and model-risk-validator are independent: never assign them to review work they helped produce, and never let them fix what they find; the fix goes back to the maker.
Findings use severity ratings.

departments.name: Legal
departments.purpose: contracts, terms, privacy and intellectual property

departments.name: Strategy & Research
departments.purpose: market research, competitors and business strategy
